digital_plan.reason: Uses semantic targets only and performs no hardware I/O

simulated_dry_run.reason: Uses the hash-bound nominal scene, target maps, tool-tip clearance, synthetic vision, diagnostic URDF IK, and controller emulation; it cannot open hardware or release physical gates

camera_capture.reason: Standalone arm includes no camera; selected candidate has not been received or bound by stable identity

arm_feedback.reason: RC03 safe_to_power_robot is false and arm/controller/firmware identity is open

empty_cell_motion.reason: Physical release, frame contract, reference, reach, collision, E-stop, and gravity-safe gates are incomplete

keyboard_contact.reason: Motion, calibration, contact-guard, force/travel, station, device, and commissioning gates are incomplete

phone_contact.reason: Motion, calibration, contact-guard, force/travel, screen, station, device, and commissioning gates are incomplete
